description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `capitalizeWords(text)` koja svaku reč piše sa velikim početnim slovom, a ostala slova malim. Reči se razdvajaju razmakom.

Primeri:
- `capitalizeWords('hello world')` → `'Hello World'`
- `capitalizeWords('hELLO wORLD')` → `'Hello World'`
- `capitalizeWords('')` → `''`

Razmaci ostaju kakvi jesu, pa `'a  b'` (dva razmaka) daje `'A  B'`.
description.en:
Write a function `capitalizeWords(text)` that writes every word with a capital first letter and the other letters in lowercase. Words are separated by a space.

Examples:
- `capitalizeWords('hello world')` → `'Hello World'`
- `capitalizeWords('hELLO wORLD')` → `'Hello World'`
- `capitalizeWords('')` → `''`

Spaces stay as they are, so `'a  b'` (two spaces) gives `'A  B'`.

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function capitalizeWords` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(text)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: kad pozovemo `capitalizeWords('hello world')`, unutar funkcije je `text` jednako `'hello world'`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 6.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function capitalizeWords` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(text)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: when we call `capitalizeWords('hello world')`, inside the function `text` equals `'hello world'`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 6 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Počinje izraz koji se nastavlja u sledećim linijama.

- `return text` ne završava naredbu na kraju linije: sledeća linija počinje tačkom (`.split`), pa JavaScript zna da se izraz nastavlja. Tako se lanac metoda piše preko više linija radi čitljivosti.
- Zamka: da je `return` sam u liniji, a `text` u sledećoj, JavaScript bi automatski dodao tačku-zarez posle `return` i funkcija bi vratila `undefined`. Zato `text` mora da bude u istoj liniji kao `return`.
- Tok izraza: tekst → niz reči → niz reči sa velikim početnim slovom → nazad u tekst.
text.en:
The start of an expression that continues in the following lines.

- `return text` does not end the statement at the end of the line: the next line starts with a dot (`.split`), so JavaScript knows the expression continues. This is how a chain of methods is written across several lines for readability.
- A trap: if `return` were alone on a line and `text` on the next, JavaScript would automatically insert a semicolon after `return` and the function would return `undefined`. That is why `text` has to be on the same line as `return`.
- The flow of the expression: text → array of words → array of capitalized words → back to text.

text.sr:
Sečemo tekst na reči.

- `.split(' ')` seče string svuda gde se nalazi jedan razmak i vraća niz delova. `'hello world'` postaje `['hello', 'world']`.
- Svaki razmak je razdelnik, pa dva razmaka zaredom daju prazan string između: `'a  b'` postaje `['a', '', 'b']`. To se koristi kasnije da razmaci ostanu sačuvani.
text.en:
We cut the text into words.

- `.split(' ')` cuts the string everywhere there is a single space and returns an array of pieces. `'hello world'` becomes `['hello', 'world']`.
- Every space is a separator, so two spaces in a row give an empty string between them: `'a  b'` becomes `['a', '', 'b']`. This is used later so the spaces are preserved.

text.sr:
Svaku reč pretvaramo u reč sa velikim početnim slovom.

- `.map(...)` poziva funkciju za svaki element niza i pravi **novi** niz od vraćenih vrednosti. `(word) => ...` je ta funkcija; `word` je trenutna reč.
- `word ? A : word` je ternarni operator: ako je `word` „istinit“ (neprazan string), računa se `A`; inače se vraća `word` kakav jeste. Prazan string je neistinit, pa prazni delovi (od dvostrukih razmaka) ostaju prazni.
- To štiti od greške: `''[0]` je `undefined`, a `undefined.toUpperCase()` baca `TypeError`.
- `A` je `word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase()`. `word[0]` je prvo slovo, a `.toUpperCase()` ga pretvara u veliko.
- `word.slice(1)` je ostatak reči od indeksa 1 nadalje, a `.toLowerCase()` ga pretvara u mala slova.
- `+` između dva stringa ih spaja (nadovezuje).
- Spoljne zagrade oko ternarnog izraza služe samo čitljivosti.

Tok za `'hELLO'`:

```
word[0]                    → 'h'  → toUpperCase → 'H'
word.slice(1)              → 'ELLO' → toLowerCase → 'ello'
'H' + 'ello'               → 'Hello'
```
text.en:
We turn each word into a word with a capital first letter.

- `.map(...)` calls a function for each element of the array and creates a **new** array from the returned values. `(word) => ...` is that function; `word` is the current word.
- `word ? A : word` is the ternary operator: if `word` is “truthy” (a non-empty string), `A` is computed; otherwise `word` is returned as it is. An empty string is falsy, so the empty pieces (from double spaces) stay empty.
- That protects from an error: `''[0]` is `undefined`, and `undefined.toUpperCase()` throws a `TypeError`.
- `A` is `word[0].toUpperCase() + word.slice(1).toLowerCase()`. `word[0]` is the first letter, and `.toUpperCase()` turns it into a capital.
- `word.slice(1)` is the rest of the word from index 1 onward, and `.toLowerCase()` turns it into lowercase.
- `+` between two strings joins them (concatenates).
- The outer parentheses around the ternary expression are only for readability.

Flow for `'hELLO'`:

```
word[0]                    → 'h'   → toUpperCase → 'H'
word.slice(1)              → 'ELLO' → toLowerCase → 'ello'
'H' + 'ello'               → 'Hello'
```

text.sr:
Spajamo reči nazad u jedan tekst.

- `.join(' ')` spaja elemente niza u string, a između njih ubacuje jedan razmak.
- Pošto su prazni delovi ostali u nizu, oni daju uzastopne razmake: `['A', '', 'B'].join(' ')` je `'A  B'`. Zato se razmaci čuvaju, uključujući one na početku i kraju.
- `;` završava celu naredbu `return` koja počinje u liniji 2.
text.en:
We join the words back into one text.

- `.join(' ')` joins the array's elements into a string, putting a single space between them.
- Since the empty pieces stayed in the array, they produce consecutive spaces: `['A', '', 'B'].join(' ')` is `'A  B'`. That is why spaces are preserved, including those at the start and the end.
- `;` ends the whole `return` statement that starts on line 2.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Lanac `split` → `map` → `join` je čest obrazac: tekst u niz, obrada svakog elementa, pa nazad u tekst.
note.en: The `split` → `map` → `join` chain is a common pattern: text to an array, processing each element, then back to text.
